findings.summary: The financial report's horizontally scrollable fee and payment tables cannot be scrolled using the keyboard.
findings.fix: Make both report table scroll containers keyboard-focusable with tabindex=0 and give each an accessible name.
findings.evidence: Both div.student-table-scroll wrappers lacked tabindex while dashboard.css applied overflow-x: auto.

notes: Static source review only; no runtime keyboard or print-dialog scan was performed.
